messages.content: trial=reuse-repair_injected_3（独立重复实验编号，与任务无关）
你是算法能力工厂的 Curator。下面是一次被验证器发现、随后修复成功的代码问题。把它提炼为一条可复用的经验（LessonRecord）：title 一句话概括，trigger 写现象/报错，fix 写通用的修复方法（不要只描述这一处改动），applies_to 填相关的条件标签（从 condition_tags 中选）。error_code 与诊断码一致。

<<CONTEXT>>
{
 "operator_purpose": "计算增值服务总数以捕捉用户粘性特征",
 "diagnostic": {
  "code": "E_INTERFACE",
  "stage": "static",
  "message": "meta.params 与 __init__ 默认值不一致：[\"service_cols: meta=['online_security', 'tech_support', 'streaming_tv'], __init__=('online_security', 'tech_support', 'streaming_tv')\"]",
  "operator": "AddServiceCount",
  "hint": "实例化时 meta.params 会覆盖 __init__ 默认值，两处必须一致"
 },
 "code_diff": "--- \n+++ \n@@ -19,3 +19,3 @@\n \n-    def __init__(self, service_cols=(\"online_security\", \"tech_support\", \"streaming_tv\")):\n+    def __init__(self, service_cols=[\"online_security\", \"tech_support\", \"streaming_tv\"]):\n         self.service_cols = service_cols\n@@ -29,4 +29,3 @@\n         # 统计增值服务数量\n-        # 根据业务经验，通常判定逻辑为值等于\"Yes\"或\"是\"\n-        # 兼容处理：将缺失值视为未订购\n+        # 根据业务经验，通常判定逻辑为值等于\"Yes\"、\"是\"或\"1\"\n         count = np.zeros(len(X))\n@@ -34,4 +33,4 @@\n             if col in X.columns:\n-                # 统一转为字符串并剔除空格进行匹配\n-                val = X[col].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()\n+                # 统一转为字符串并剔除空格进行匹配，兼容缺失值\n+                val = X[col].fillna(\"no\").astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()\n                 count += (val.isin([\"yes\", \"是\", \"1\"])).astype(int)\n@@ -40,3 +39,3 @@\n         \n-        # 处理可能的缺失值或异常数值（虽然此逻辑不产生NaN，但遵循规范兜底）\n+        # 处理可能的异常数值（虽然此逻辑不产生NaN/inf，但遵循规范兜底）\n         X[\"n_services\"] = X[\"n_services\"].fillna(0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)",
 "condition_tags": [
  "has_missing_values",
  "has_categorical_features",
  "low_cardinality",
  "high_cardinality",
  "numeric_features",
  "string_typed_numeric",
  "id_columns",
  "linear_model",
  "scaled_features",
  "nonlinear",
  "mixed_features",
  "large_tabular",
  "imbalanced",
  "recall_first",
  "interpretable",
  "feature_importance",
  "sparse_features",
  "text_input",
  "time_tenure"
 ]
}
<</CONTEXT>>

Respond with a single JSON object only, no prose, conforming to this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"DiagnosticCode": {"enum": ["E_SYNTAX", "E_UNSAFE", "E_INTERFACE", "E_RUNTIME", "E_TIMEOUT", "E_SHAPE", "E_PROBA", "E_MUTATION", "E_NAN", "M_THRESHOLD", "M_UNSTABLE"], "title": "DiagnosticCode", "type": "string"}}, "properties": {"title": {"title": "Title", "type": "string"}, "trigger": {"description": "什么情况下会出现这个问题（现象/报错）", "title": "Trigger", "type": "string"}, "fix": {"description": "如何修复或规避", "title": "Fix", "type": "string"}, "error_code": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/DiagnosticCode"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}, "applies_to": {"description": "相关的算子名、条件标签或场景名", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Applies To", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["title", "trigger", "fix"], "title": "LessonRecord", "type": "object"}

response:
{
  "title": "确保算子元数据与构造函数默认参数类型一致",
  "trigger": "算子类定义的 meta 参数（或配置列表）与 __init__ 方法中的默认值类型不一致（如 List vs Tuple），导致实例化或配置校验阶段报错。",
  "fix": "统一初始化参数与元数据描述中的类型（例如统一为 list），并确保 __init__ 默认值与算子描述中的配置项类型完全匹配，以符合框架对配置规范的要求。",
  "error_code": "E_INTERFACE",
  "applies_to": [
    "has_categorical_features",
    "mixed_features",
    "feature_importance"
  ]
}
